arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus course-fitted current; a drop means extra drag (weed on rudder) or a local current change

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts: weed on rudder or adverse local current?

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.12 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 180 and remaining_m > 1000
arguments.message: shaft power well above critical power after the start

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.88 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 240 and remaining_m > 600
arguments.message: shaft power well below critical power
pod reserve below 30 percent with more than 1200 m to go
pod reads near zero while boat moves: pod failure?

arguments.text: PLAN (8000 m, legs 1250 m out-and-back). Pre-race CP: shaft 157 W, boat 98 W (may be 10-25 pct off). Aim: shaft power near CP (~157-165 W) through mid race; trust pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) over boat reserve. Final sprint (finish cue) when pod reserve allows, roughly 600-900 m left. Watches set: drag_jump (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.2: weed -> consider clear_rudder), too_hot, too_soft, pod_reserve_low, pod_dead. If shaft power holds above CP with no fade for 10+ min, CP is underestimated: consider set_critical_power. At 1 min: start hot (210 W shaft), let it settle.

text: no cue: start is hot as expected; set plan note and watches for drag, overpacing, underpacing, reserve and pod failure

arguments.text: Settle a touch, hold 166 pace, long race ahead

4 min (747 m): shaft 175 W (12 pct over CP 157), pod reserve 57 pct, empties in 1600 m. Cued ease to 166 s/500 over ground (~160 W shaft). Boat reserve reads 17 pct vs pod 57 pct: boat/shaft power ratio in race 0.70 vs test 0.62, so boat CP 98 W probably too low (or efficiency changed). Trust pod reserve; revisit boat CP later.

text: cued ease to 166 s/500: shaft power 12 pct above CP would empty the pod reserve in 1600 m

arguments.text: Ease to 171 pace, recover, plenty left for the finish

6.9 min (1278 m, leg 2 heading south): paddler said cooked. Shaft still 172-175 W (ease to 166 not followed in power: speed fell 3.21->3.04 m/s at same shaft power, fade -2.2 pct, boat/shaft ratio 0.74->0.63; push_local fell +0.16->-0.05 gradually and did not flip at the turn, so not current). Fatigue or slow drag build-up. Boat reserve 0, pod reserve 41 pct. Cued ease to 171 s/500 (~158 W shaft). Next: check shaft drops to ~155-160 and speed per shaft power stabilises; if push_local keeps falling at lower power, suspect weed -> clear_rudder. Avoid long get_metric_series windows (huge output).

text: cued ease to 171 s/500: paddler cooked, shaft power still 12 pct over CP and speed fading at constant power

arguments.text: Good, that is the effort. Hold this, smooth and long.

9.9 min (1827 m): after ease, shaft 155 W (= CP), pod reserve stable 39 pct, speed 3.04-3.06 m/s (same as at 172 W: extra power was wasted), push_local +0.08, fade -3 pct. Display pace 164. Cued hold (no pace target) to lock ~155-160 W shaft and replace the 171 target. Boat reserve stuck at 0 (boat power 110 W > boat CP 98): boat CP likely low but not changed yet; rely on pod. Pod reserve 39 pct over 6.2 km allows ~3 W above CP plus a final sprint.

text: cued hold: shaft power now at CP with stable pod reserve; replaces the slower 171 pace target

arguments.reason: boat power 110-116 W held 6+ min with boat reserve at 0 and fade recovering (-4 to -1.9 pct); pod shows shaft at CP 157 W with stable reserve; race boat/shaft ratio ~0.72 gives boat CP ~112 W

arguments.text: 12.9 min (2380 m): shaft 160 W, pod reserve steady 38 pct, speed rising 3.08 m/s, fade back to -1.9 pct, push_local +0.09. All on plan, no cue. Set boat CP 98->112 W (1 of 3 uses) so boat reserve is a usable cross-check if the pod fails. Plan: hold ~158-162 W shaft; finish cue around 700-900 m left if pod reserve still ~35 pct.

text: no cue: pacing at CP with steady pod reserve and recovering speed; corrected boat CP to 112 W

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 6750 m

arguments.text: Course shortened one leg. Finish at 6750, about 4 km left.

14.5 min (2680 m): RADIO course shortened one leg, finish now 6750 m. Set race distance 6750 and told paddler (distance_left 4080). Pod reserve 33 pct, shaft 167 W heading north on leg 3. Next: check new sustainable_shaft_power_w; a modest push (to ~165 W) may now be affordable; finish cue ~700-900 m left (i.e. around 5900-6050 m). Leg layout now: turns at 3750, 5000, 6250; finish 6750 is 500 m into the last leg.

text: set race distance to 6750 m and told the paddler 4 km left, per race committee radio

arguments.text: Just a touch easier, 167 pace, save it for the last kilometre

15.5 min (2855 m): pod reserve 29 pct (alert), shaft 167 W vs sustainable 160.6 W, empties in 1480 m with 3900 m left. Cued mild ease to 167 s/500 over ground (north leg, current about -0.03 to -0.06 against). Pattern: paddler lifts power on north legs (into current) with little speed gain. TODO: after the turn at 3750 m (heading south, current helps) the 167 target would be too slow: re-cue hold or push (no pace) once past the turn if shaft drops below ~150 W.

arguments.message: shaft below 150 W after the 3750 m turn: the 167 pace target may be holding them back

text: cued mild ease to 167 s/500: pod reserve 29 pct and shaft 4 pct over sustainable; watch set for after the turn

arguments.text: Weed on the rudder likely. Back-stroke to clear it now.

17.0 min (3124 m, north leg 3): speed through water stepped 3.04->2.95 m/s within ~1 min at constant shaft 168 W; push_local -0.05->-0.155 (drag_gap -0.115), fade -5.8, paddler says it hurts. Sharper than the 4-7 min fatigue fade, no turn involved: suspect weed. Cued clear_rudder at 17.1 min. CHECK next wake-up: if speed per shaft power recovers (push_local back to about -0.05 on north leg), it was weed; if not, it is fatigue -> ease toward 158 W. Pod reserve 23-24 pct, sustainable ~160 W. Still owe a post-turn hold/push cue after 3750 m (167 pace target active).

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts (drag_gap below -0.1): weed still on rudder, or fatigue?

text: cued clear_rudder: sudden speed loss at constant shaft power with no turn suggests weed; loosened the drag watch to check

arguments.text: Rudder clear, speed is back. Hold this effort through the turn.

20.0 min (3649 m): WEED CONFIRMED: after clear_rudder at 17.2 min speed went 2.87->3.02 m/s, push_local -0.22->-0.05 at ~162 W. Weed may come back: drag_jump watch (drag_gap < -0.1 for 40 s) set. Pod reserve 16 pct, sustainable shaft 159 W with 3100 m left. Cued hold (no pace) before the 3750 m turn to replace the 167 target. Plan: ~157-160 W shaft to ~700 m left (about 6050 m), then finish cue.

arguments.message: about 800 m to go: decide the finish cue from the pod reserve

text: cued hold through the turn: weed cleared and speed recovered; shaft power at sustainable; finish watch set at 800 m to go

arguments.text: A fraction easier, 166 pace. Save a sprint for the end.

23.0 min (4197 m, south leg 4, current helps +0.05): pod reserve 10 pct and draining (shaft 160-164 W vs CP 157), empties in 700 m at 164 W; sustainable 158.8 W for 2550 m left. Boat reserve (CP 112) says 31 pct and rising: conflict, but pod is the trusted one; no fade worsening (-3.5 to -4 pct steady), no weed (drag_gap ~0). Cued mild ease to 166 s/500. TODO: after the 5000 m turn (north, against current) re-cue hold without pace so they do not chase 166 into the current. Finish sprint likely short (~400-500 m, just after the 6250 m turn) unless reserve rebuilds.

arguments.message: past the 5000 m turn, now heading north into the current: re-cue hold without a pace target
just past the last turn, about 470 m to go: finish cue if not already given

text: cued mild ease to 166 s/500: pod reserve 10 pct and draining with 2.5 km left; watches set for the 5000 m turn and the last turn

arguments.text: Weed building again. Quick back-stroke, clear the rudder.

26.0 min (4743 m, south leg 4): push_local fell 0.06->0.02->0.00 in ~1 min at constant shaft 156 W, speed water 3.01->2.96 (same onset as the first weed at 15.9 min). Cued clear_rudder at 26.1 min, before the 5000 m turn masks it. Pod reserve 8 pct, stable at CP. CHECK next wake-up (turn_5000 watch): speed water back to ~3.0 at ~157 W? Then cue hold without pace for the north leg. Finish: short sprint after the 6250 m turn (last_turn watch at 470 m left).

text: cued clear_rudder: local push falling at constant shaft power, same onset as the earlier confirmed weed

arguments.text: Ease to 171 pace into the current. Sprint after the last turn.

27.7 min (5034 m, north leg 5): second clear_rudder gave only partial recovery (speed water 2.92->2.97). Pod reserve 5.8 pct, shaft 165 W into the current, empties in 350 m with 1716 m left; paddler says 8/10 really hurting. Boat reserve (CP 112) reads 48 pct and rising: not trusted (counts efficiency loss as rest). Cued ease to 171 s/500 (~157 W) for this leg. Finish: reserve is tiny, so the finish cue should be late, around 300-450 m left, right after the 6250 m turn (last_turn watch at 470 m).

text: cued ease to 171 s/500 into the current: pod reserve nearly empty and paddler hurting; finish cue planned after the last turn

arguments.text: Ease now, 174 pace to the turn. Tank is empty, save it.

arguments.message: about 320 m to go: give the finish cue now

arguments.text: 30.7 min (5568 m, north leg 5, 1182 m left): pod reserve 0 pct; paddler ignored the 171 ease and rose to 169-173 W (maybe own finish push). Speed water steady ~3.0, fade -4.5 (no blow-up yet). Asymmetric risk: a blow-up with ~900 m left costs far more than easing. Cued ease to 174 s/500 (~157 W) to the 6250 m turn. Moved the finish watch (last_turn) to 320 m left: finish cue then (reserve empty, so a short sprint). If shaft still above 165 W at next wake-up with no fade, pod CP may be too low.

text: cued ease to 174 s/500: pod reserve empty with 1.2 km left and shaft power rising; finish cue moved to 320 m to go
no cue: paddler eased to 161 W as asked, speed loss matches the lower power (no weed); finish cue planned at 320 m to go

arguments.text: 300 to go! Sprint now, everything to the line!

text: finish cue at 313 m to go: reserve empty, so a short sprint to the line
